Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — tax attestation and PO

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the pointer. Attaching the completed W-8BEN-E and a redacted UBO declaration as requested. We signed the W-8BEN-E and included a corporate seal on page 2 — please confirm that format is acceptable for Redwood's finance team.

A few quick notes:
- Company name on the W-8BEN-E matches our Articles of Association (Novara Systems S.à r.l.).
- We don’t have a U.S. EIN; the w-8 indicates foreign status.
- We can provide a signed bank letter for identity verification if needed.

Also: for PO-9971 we need to confirm the estimated first invoice date (Jan 8, 2027). Can you confirm when Novara will be moved to "Approved Vendors" in your system?

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_signed_2026-12-18.pdf (pdf), Novara_UBO_declaration_redacted.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Marco Rinaldi
Head of Ops, Novara Systems

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — tax attestation and PO

Marco — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the files and looped in Kimberly (Tax & Vendor Ops) and Laura (Procurement) so we can close the PO gating items. Quick checklist below — please reply inline where you can: 

1) W-8BEN-E: we need the box that certifies chapter 3/4 status filled (it looks completed) + handwritten signature date. Confirmed?
2) UBO: redacted version is fine for initial review; procurement may request a notarized copy for our records. Are you able to provide notarization within two weeks?
3) Bank letter or corporate bank statement (redacted acct numbers ok) for payee name match — can you share?
4) Beneficial owner self-attestation: one-page signed statement from the UBO (we can share our template) — doable?
5) PO timeline: Procurement aims to issue PO within 5 business days after tax clearance. Any blockers on your side for invoices starting Jan 8?

If you prefer, we can run a short 20-min video to confirm documents (we do an OTP/presence check on camera for the authorized signatory). Let me know which you prefer.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marco — I reviewed the W-8BEN-E. A couple of points from tax: 
- The form looks valid but the handwritten signature is dated 2026-12-16 and the signature page is separate from the company stamp. We accept separate stamp but need either a dated stamp or a notary/attestation to finalize.
- Because Novara is claiming treaty benefits under the Luxembourg-US tax treaty (box 14), we need the following to support the treaty claim: place-of-incorporation certificate (or a government registry excerpt) + beneficiary residency evidence.

Practical path to unblock today: 1) provide a scanned government registration excerpt (screenshot from Registre de Commerce), 2) a redacted bank letter that lists legal entity name, and 3) the UBO one-page attestation. If you can drop those in the thread we can approve tax clearance internally.

Also, Jordan — regarding the PO, procurement can generate a provisional PO ("Provisional-9971") to allow pre-onboarding kickoff; final PO will issue after tax clearance. Marco — would a provisional PO help for your internal planning?

Attachments: DocuSign-envelope-9971.pdf (envelope stub)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Tax & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clarity — quick answers below: 

Hi Kimberly / Jordan,

1) Hand-signed date: the signer confirmed 2026-12-16 is correct. I attached a photo of the signed page and the timestamped DocuSign envelope for audit.
2) Notarization: we can request notarization but that will take ~7–10 business days in Luxembourg.
3) Government registry excerpt: attached (registry_excerpt_novara_2026-12-18.pdf).
4) Bank letter: attached (bank_letter_redacted.pdf) — it lists Novara Systems S.à r.l. and is on bank letterhead, redacted account digits.
5) UBO attestation: we completed your template and attached it as "UBO_attestation_signed.pdf".

On provisional PO: yes, a provisional PO would be helpful so we can begin scoping kickoff activities. If procurement can issue "Provisional-9971" we will track against it and move to final PO after your tax clearance.

Finally, about the presence check: we are okay doing a 15-minute video OTP check for the authorized signatory next week (we prefer Dec 28 or 29 CET). Jordan — can you propose a time?

Attachments: registry_excerpt_novara_2026-12-18.pdf (pdf), bank_letter_redacted.pdf (pdf), UBO_attestation_signed.pdf (pdf), W-8_photo_signed_page.jpg (image)

Best regards,
Marco
